description: This source file contains functions for exporting behavioral observation data in various formats, including behavioral sequences, tabular data, aggregated events, and Praat TextGrid files, within the BORIS behavioral research software.

methods.name: export_events_as_behavioral_sequences
methods.description: Exports selected observation events as behavioral sequences in a plain text file, with options for separated subjects and timing.

methods.name: export_tabular_events
methods.description: Exports selected observation events in various tabular formats such as TSV, CSV, ODS, XLSX, XLS, HTML, or for jwatcher, in a data format.

methods.name: export_aggregated_events
methods.description: Exports aggregated behavioral events in formats including SQL, SDIS, tabular, or pandas DataFrame, with options for grouping and formatting.

methods.name: export_events_as_textgrid
methods.description: Exports state events of selected observations as Praat TextGrid files, including handling of timestamps, intervals, and overlapping events.
